title: Voyager 1 Is Now 16 Billion Miles Away. A Message Takes a Day

scenes.text: This spacecraft is so far away, a message takes a full day to reach it.
Voyager 1 launched in 1977. Today it is about sixteen billion miles from Earth.
NASA says it reaches one light-day this November. That's twenty-four hours for a radio signal, one way.
Send it a command today, and you wait about two days for the reply.
It still works. Barely. Most instruments are off to save power.
A machine from 1977 that is still sending messages from a day away.

description:
Voyager 1 is about to be one full light-day from Earth.
Launched in 1977, it is roughly sixteen billion miles away, so a radio signal needs about 24 hours to reach it. NASA expects it to cross the mark in November 2026.
What would you send to Voyager if you could? Comment below.
